title: Onboarding storyboard: lens frames for latency, per-token cost, and trace explorer
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Design and deliver a set of high-fidelity onboarding storyboard frames (lens frames) and exported screenshots that illustrate three core observability views: 1) end-to-end latency breakdown (ingest -> runtime -> network), 2) cost-per-token insights and sample token-level cost callouts, and 3) trace explorer focused on a slow request root-cause flow. These assets will be used in the Console quickstart, product docs, and marketing one-pagers for the console-2025.03 release. Key goals: make complex telemetry approachable for first-time users, highlight actionable levers (batching, model variant fallback, cache), and provide both desktop and mobile legible exports.
acceptance_criteria: Three distinct storyboard frames completed in Figma: latency-breakdown, cost-token-insight, trace-explorer-flow
Each frame exported to PNG and SVG at desktop (1440x900) and mobile (375x812) sizes following export spec
Annotated callouts included on each export with concise guidance (<= 14 words per callout) and CTA to related Console feature pages
Files uploaded to Drive + asset CDN and links added to Console quickstart doc and PRD
Design review approvals from PM and Engineering and a signed-off implementation checklist for engineering to recreate interactive lens components
tasks: Draft storyboard roughs for three observability lenses and circulate for PM feedback
Create high-fidelity Figma frames with consistent token usage (type, spacing, color) per brand guidelines
Add contextual annotations calling out: 95th/99th latency, per-token cost delta, problematic service spans
Export assets to PNG/SVG at required resolutions and compress for web
Produce alternate color-blind friendly palette variants and include in zipped deliverable
Link assets in Console quickstart doc + open docs PR (doc PR URL in attachments)
Handoff to frontend with spec sheet (CSS tokens, recommended transitions, overlay behavior)
